Support responded to my critical outage ticket in under 10 minutes and fixed it live on the call. Genuinely impressed.
Shoutout to the support team — they walked me through a tricky migration issue patiently and even followed up the next day to confirm it worked.
Customer support has been excellent every time I've reached out, way better than our previous vendor.
Mobile app crashes every time I try to sync memories while offline mode is on.
iOS app force-closes on background sync if there are more than ~500 pending items queued.

Really appreciate how transparent the changelog has been about breaking changes recently. Small thing but it matters.
Really solid experience overall, the CLI tools especially make local dev testing painless.
